For Immediate Release—November 10th, 2026




  South Carolina Public Service Commission Schedules Hearing in South Carolina Public
           Service Authority’s (Santee Cooper) 2026 Integrated Resource Plan


Columbia, South Carolina—The Public Service Commission of South Carolina has scheduled a hearing in
Docket No. 2026-18-E, which involves South Carolina Public Service Authority’s (Santee Cooper) 2026
Integrated Resource Plan. Santee Cooper’s 2026 Integrated Resource Plan can be reviewed at this link.

This hearing has been scheduled to begin on Monday, May 24th, 2027, at 10 a.m. and will continue through the
remainder of the week (May 25th-28th) if necessary. Start times on subsequent days will be determined by the
Chairman.

More information about this matter can be found on the Commission’s Docket Management System at
this link. A recording of the IRP hearing may be viewed online once it concludes and can be found at
this link.

For more information, follow the Commission on Facebook, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, and Instagram, email
contact@psc.sc.gov, or call 803.896.5100.
